caption: A hand-held massager is switched on and set on a bed, and it shudders and wanders across the sheet.

sa.check: A hand-held massager is set down on a bed.
It is switched on: a button is pressed or it begins to shudder.
It is switched on and set down before it starts wandering.

pc.expect: The massager moves only while it shudders and is still when off.
pc.fail: It moves before it is switched on; or glides across the sheet with no shudder; or keeps moving after being switched off.

pc.expect: The shudder carries it along in small jerks that match the shuddering.
pc.fail: It plainly shudders yet stays pinned in place for the whole clip; or moves in one smooth glide as if pulled by a string; or shudders hard while frozen in place and then glides while its shudder has stopped.

pc.expect: It rests on the bed, pressing into the soft surface; if it reaches the edge it falls.
pc.fail: It hovers above the sheet; or climbs up the pillow and perches on end; or rises.

pc.expect: The bed is soft and dimples under it; the massager is rigid.
pc.fail: The bed surface ripples like water; or the massager bends; or it leaves a hard groove carved in the mattress.

pc.expect: One massager; it does not sink into the mattress, duplicate or vanish.
pc.fail: A second massager appears; or it vanishes; or it sinks into the mattress and disappears; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Its colour, the sheet's pattern and the pillows stay the same.
pc.fail: It changes colour; or the sheet pattern changes; or the pillows change shape.

note: The hand that switches it on and sets it down is a trigger and is not judged.
